title: Chapter 212: The Threat Of Decapitation Operation
content:
Chapter 212: The Threat Of Decapitation Operation

Wu Qing looked at the demon warriors in the center of the demon army and asked Naga Yi beside him: "Elder, will killing those demon warriors in the center of the demon army in advance have a big impact on this war?"

Naga Yi turned her head and glanced at Wu Qing, and smiled: "Can you kill them from such a long distance? Don't think about using siege troops to attack them, it's useless!"

Naga Yi saw Wu Qing smiling but didn't say anything, so she continued: "If you really have a way to kill them, of course it will have a great impact on the operations of the demon army!"

"Although the demon army has a mysterious potential command system that can organize the demon army to continue fighting under any circumstances, this is simply not comparable to operations directly commanded by commanders!"

"If you can really kill that group of demon warriors, our army may not really need to participate in this war!"

"Just watch you fight!"

Naga Yi explained to Wu Qing.

"Then wait for our other troops, and when they arrive, launch the attack!"

Wu Qing smiled.

In the current battlefield situation, the Zerg army can already start the attack. The Zerg flying troops will come later, which will not affect the battle here.

But Wu Qing has tasted the sweetness of the decapitation operation and wants to do it again here. He asked Naga this question just to explain to Naga why the Zerg did not take the initiative to attack now.

Otherwise, Naga would have some thoughts when she saw that the Zerg army was ready, but she kept watching the demon army arranging troops and did not take the initiative.

Even if Naga said that the decapitation operation would have no effect on the next war, Wu Qing would choose to wait for the Zerg queen to arrive and carry out the decapitation operation.

The terrible decapitation ability of the Zerg, displayed here, is a powerful deterrent.

Especially to show the Tengu tribe, the Zerg's ability to kill people silently and invisibly is the biggest threat to the Tengu tribe!

The Zerg's flying troops did not let Wu Qing wait for long. Before the battle formations of both sides were fully arranged, a black mass of flying creatures appeared on the southern horizon and flew towards the battlefield at high speed.

In addition to the Zerg army, the Naga army and the Demon army were alert.

Naga's eyesight was excellent. She quickly saw the appearance of those flying creatures. She could see obvious Zerg characteristics. Knowing that this was the Zerg army Wu Qing had just mentioned, she felt relieved.

"Is this the army you are waiting for? All flying soldiers?"

"I didn't expect that you would even send flying soldiers here!"

Naga said to Wu Qing with some sighs.

"We will use this as a starting point and go to the world. As long as it is a Zerg army, it will appear here!"

Wu Qing responded.

Naga kindly reminded: "This place is almost surrounded by the Endless Mountains. The Endless Mountains are a famous forbidden place. Even if you have the protection of a powerful person, you still need to be careful!"

"Every forbidden place has great terror!"

For Naga 妶's reminder, Wu Qing thanked: "Thank you for the elder's reminder, we will be careful!"

The Zerg flying dragon group flew from far to near. When they flew near the battlefield, they stopped approaching and began to circle in the sky.

The Zerg flying dragon group that covered the sky and the sun seemed to be flying in a disorderly manner, but in fact they occupied a large area of the sky in an orderly manner.

The Zerg Queen has arrived and is hiding in the Zerg flying dragon group.

The Naga army and the demon army, including those observers, can see the appearance of the Zerg flying dragon. Everyone can easily judge that this is the flying arm of the Zerg.

Some common characteristics of the Zerg's appearance are still very obvious.

The demon army has strengthened its air defense, and a large number of flame demons are on air alert.

The Naga army was relieved. The Zerg had a strong army to help them, so there was no suspense in this battle.

Observers from various forces on a high ground near the battlefield were all sighing at the Zerg's boldness, completely ignoring the special situation here.

"We are about to start. I wonder if the Tengu observers can understand it!"

Wu Qing said to Naga.

Hearing this, Naga focused her attention on the center of the demon army and said, "Don't worry, those who can be sent out as observers are not mediocre people. Even if they don't see it clearly for a while, they will react soon!"

After receiving Wu Qing's order, fifteen Zerg queens quietly launched an egg-laying attack on the fifteen most powerful demons in the center of the demon army from a very long distance.

A string of special spores that seemed invisible and intangible invaded the bodies of the demons in a way that ordinary people could not understand.

During the attack process of the Zerg queen, no one on the battlefield noticed it, including the demons who were attacked.

Naga, who had been keeping a close eye on the demon warriors in the center of the demon army, suddenly saw that the demon warriors looked a little strange, and then they began to self-destruct one by one, from the inside out, and exploded into pieces!

Before she could figure out what was going on, the demon warriors who self-destructed turned into a beam of light and disappeared!

Only the strongest fire demon was left, still holding on in pain!

"Look at the center of the demon army! Those demon warriors suddenly self-destructed!"

An observer who happened to see this scene shouted, attracting the attention of all observers to the center of the demon army.

Observers who reacted quickly also saw the self-explosion of several powerful demons. Observers who did not react in time only saw those powerful demons in the middle of the demon army disappear in an instant, leaving only the strongest flame demon, whose state was very strange.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

The strongest flame demon in the demon army should have reached five-star strength. The three-star Zerg queen's egg-laying power was still a little insufficient, so it persisted.

Another Zerg queen in the Zerg flying dragon group that had not used egg-laying attack launched another egg-laying attack on it.

The powerful flame demon who was fighting against the self-explosive parasites in his body had new self-explosive parasites appear in his body again, absorbing its energy and vitality with extremely high efficiency and growing rapidly, which made it completely desperate.

With a crisp sound of "pop!", the strongest demon of the demon clan in this area self-exploded and died in full view of the public, and then disappeared into light, leaving nothing behind.

"What's going on?"

"All the strong men of the demon clan blew themselves up!"

"Did the strong men of the Naga clan take action? Or the strong men of the Zerg clan?"

"The strong men of the Naga clan won't come here, and they don't have such means of attack!"

"It should be the newly entered Zerg clan! They even sent flying soldiers here, and there must be strong men accompanying them!"

"The Zerg clan entered the world in this area, and there must be powerful people to protect them at any time. They should have ways to protect themselves, and don't have to worry about taboos!"

"Before the war started, there was a decapitation operation. Now the combat power of the demon clan army has to drop by several levels!"

"The outcome of this war is a foregone conclusion! It depends on how the Naga clan and the Zerg clan can reduce losses!"

"I didn't expect that the Zerg clan would forcefully drive the evil god camp out of here as soon as it entered the world. The identity of this Zerg clan should be confirmed soon!"

"It's a blessing that the local camp has one more clan!"

"..."

The discussion of the observers from all parties made the Tengu clan observers feel depressed. They sighed helplessly and kept silent.

Naga had been observing the flame demon that had persisted for a while before self-destructing. In the end, she still didn't understand how the Zerg attacked.

"What a magical way of attack!" Naga wanted to use "weird" to describe the Zerg's attack, but the word "weird" cannot be used casually in this world, so she used the word "magical" instead.

Facing such an attack by the Zerg, she also felt threatened. This unknown power is the most terrifying.

Naga could sense that Wu Qing's strength was not very strong. She was a little proud in her subconscious. Now that she had seen the weird abilities of the Zerg, she dared not despise him anymore.

Wu Qing didn't explain too much. Being strong is being strong. There is no need to be too afraid of others. The strong are respected, which is more vividly demonstrated in this world.

Naga didn't ask. The Zerg had already used this killing ability in front of her. She couldn't see the way, which was her own problem.

The demon army suddenly lost its core leaders, and there was some commotion, but their magical battlefield command system was working, and the army was not in chaos.

It was just that the demon leaders were all wiped out without a single combat order, which had a great impact.

"Attack!"

Wu Qing gave the Zerg army an attack order, and the war officially began!

"Boom boom boom...!"

More than 10,000 liquid fireball shells fired by the Zerg destroyers flew towards the demon army.

The shells fired by those star-level Zerg destroyers focused on the thousands of three-star flame demons in the demon army.

"Boom boom boom..."

The explosion sounded in various positions of the demon army phalanx. With the precise battlefield information provided by the Zerg host in the air, the Zerg destroyers could hit the target position exactly.

A large number of demon soldiers were either killed or injured in this explosion, and a large number of them fell.

Those three-star flame demons with super long range were focused on, and more than half of them disappeared in an instant. The remaining ones were all injured, and there were not many who could continue to fight.

The fire control ability of the three-star flame demons has been greatly enhanced, but the defense ability has not increased much. Their ability to resist attacks is completely incomparable to that of the dog demons.

The remaining three-star flame demons that can still fight seemed to have been attacked by something before they had time to counterattack, forcing them to give up counterattack.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg destroyers launched a second round of attacks.

The demon army began to charge, and a large number of inferior demons mixed with flame demons and dog demons rushed towards the battle formation of the Zerg army!
